scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:ssh && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:ssh: cargo test --manifest-path ssh/Cargo.toml && cargo build --manifest-path ssh/Cargo.toml --bin test-services && (cd ssh && npm test)
scripts.test:frontend: cd frontend && (bun run build || npm run build)
scripts.dev:frontend: cd frontend && (bun run dev || npm run dev)
scripts.build:all: cargo build --manifest-path backend/Cargo.toml && cargo build --manifest-path ssh/Cargo.toml && (cd frontend && (bun run build || npm run build))
